blocks.text: Student Learning Outcomes (is unit mein kya seekhenge)
Is unit ke aakhir tak aap yeh kar sakenge:

items: Software development kya hai yeh bata sakenge aur yeh kyun zaroori (important) hai, samjha sakenge.
Software development ke ahem terms samajh aur bata sakenge, jaise Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), debugging (ghaltiyan dhoond kar theek karna), testing aur design patterns.
SDLC ki stages (marahil) aur har stage ka maqsad (objective) aur us mein hone wale kaam bata sakenge.
Software development ki mukhtalif methodologies (kaam ke tareeqe) mein farq bata sakenge, jaise Waterfall model aur Agile methodology.
Software project ki planning kar sakenge: timelines (waqt ka khaka) banana, cost (kharcha) ka andaza lagana aur risks (khatre) sambhalna.
Quality assurance (mayaar ki jaanch) ke tareeqe pehchan aur istemal kar sakenge taake software achhe mayaar ka ho.
Software systems dikhane ke liye Unified Modeling Language (UML) diagrams istemal kar sakenge.
Aam software design patterns pehchan kar software design mein istemal kar sakenge.
Debugging ke tareeqe aur testing strategies istemal kar ke software ko bharosemand (reliable) bana sakenge.
Software development ke tools samajh aur istemal kar sakenge, jaise Integrated Development Environment (IDE), compilers aur source code repositories (code rakhne ki jagah).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein "testicang" chhapa hai; sahi lafz "testing" hai.

Software development ek systematic (tarteeb aur qaide wala) process hai jo users ki zarooraton (needs) ko software products mein badalta hai. Is mein kai stages (hisse) hoti hain: shuru ke analysis (jaanch) se le kar design, coding, testing aur deployment tak. Har stage ki apni ahmiyat hai aur har stage ke liye khaas skills aur tools chahiye hote hain. Software development ka process samajhna zaroori hai ta ke hum reliable (bharosay ke qabil), maintainable (aasani se theek aur update hone wala) aur scalable (barhne ke qabil) software bana sakein. Yeh chapter software development ke basic (bunyadi) concepts sikhata hai: aham terms, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), software development methodologies (kaam karne ke tareeqe), project planning aur management, quality assurance aur software design patterns.

blocks.prompt: Software development kis cheez ko kis cheez mein badalta hai, aur is ki stages kaun si hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh users ki zarooraton (needs) ko software products mein badalta hai. Stages: analysis, design, coding, testing aur deployment. Har stage ke liye khaas skills aur tools chahiye.

items: Software development: users ki needs se software product tak ek systematic process.
Is chapter mein: terms, SDLC, methodologies, project planning aur management, quality assurance, design patterns.
